name: Human 12-chemokine signature associated with lymph node-like structures
context: Human solid tumors; examined in metastatic melanoma for association with tumor-localized lymph node-like structures.
citation: Messina JL et al. Scientific Reports 2, 765 (2012). doi:10.1038/srep00765; PMID:23097687.
source_locator: Results, first paragraph: the full 12-chemokine list and the original PCA scoring method.
original_scoring: First principal component of log2 gene-expression intensities across the 12 genes; fitted PCA weights are not supplied in this membership record.
selection_rule: All 12 genes listed in the first Results paragraph, in source order; no additions, substitutions or expression-based filtering.
source_license: Article: CC BY-NC-ND 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/3.0/). This record contains the factual gene membership and original metadata, not article text or figures.
notes: Per-cell UCell scoring is an adaptation of the published tissue-level signature. Assess spatial organization when interpreting TLS. For mouse use, derive a separate record from documented ortholog mappings and retain all unmapped genes.
